_instructions: Template only. Copy this file to data/search_config.json and adjust the target roles, locations, queries, commute radius and the optional evaluation weights to your own preferences. data/search_config.json is ignored by Git. The evaluation block overrides the built-in scoring weights shown here (base_score, recommended_threshold and the weights object); after changing a value run `job-agent re-evaluate` so jobs already stored are scored again. The weights.missing_requirement values are accepted for backward compatibility only: a requirement the profile does not list is treated as unverified rather than missing, so changing those three numbers has no effect on scores.
maximum_commute_note: Describe your commute limit here; it is informational only.
